package_version_source: docs/literature/raw/description_gformula.txt; repository declaration, not proof of latest published release
capabilities: Parametric g-formula with time-varying treatments, failure times and competing events
limitation: Model specification and intervention semantics are substantive; full license text not separately retrieved
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Person-period data with explicit time, conditional covariate/outcome models, intervention functions, competing events, histories and Monte Carlo size.
scientific_qualification.output: Intervention risks or terminal means/probabilities with model and optional bootstrap/simulation diagnostics.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Sequential g-formula identification, specified transition/outcome law and meaningful event/observation conventions.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Pin current intervention syntax; preserve baselags, visitprocess, competing-event handling and sim_trunc. sim_trunc defaults TRUE for specified continuous covariate families and alters the simulated law. nsimul controls Monte Carlo precision; nsamples controls bootstrap uncertainty.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Compare full-distribution simulation with exact two-period integration and mean-path substitution; vary nsimul separately from observed sample size. Use a tail-sensitive cash-flow target to quantify simulation truncation.

evidence.finding: Outcome-specific targets, conditional models, intervention API and baseline/history variables.
Visit process, competing events, lag convention, simulation/bootstrap controls and sim_trunc.

pinned_api_revision.scope: Inspected API files at this commit; not an assertion about all README bytes or the published package release.
